world_summary.go_live_view: Close but not yet. The rigor base is strong: 26 of 28 answers are scholarly acceptable, hedges on Macrina's voice, Ep. 38, Basil's pneumatological reserve and the Thaumaturgus legend are carried faithfully, and the honest limits (F5-E, F1-T, F5-T) are exemplary. The two blocks (#1, #28) and most of the FIX answers trace to how text is assembled rather than to the records: sentences cut mid-thought leave orphaned 'So' or 'The other', and record caveats get glued to the wrong teaching. The single most valuable fix is an assembly guard that rejects any answer whose sentence opens with a back-reference ('So', 'The other', 'That was', 'it') when the preceding sentence was removed, paired with stripping system words ('turn', 'ground', 'records I hold', 'this record'). Next, cap block quotes at about 60 words.
